fusions.name: Relay Sting
fusions.desc: Sends a sting into the first enemy it meets for 4 poison damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Thousand Needles
fusions.desc: Looses 5 stings in a wide spread, each dealing 6 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tireless Shift
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Never Resting
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
